pages.quiz:
CORE MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 2/2
   C. They are equal
   D. Cannot tell

2. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.7
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

3. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 44
   B. 22
   C. 15
   D. 30

4. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 37

5. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

6. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

7. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 60
   B. 30
   C. 38
   D. 19

8. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

9. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.7
   B. 27.6
   C. 33
   D. 27

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 29
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 23.7

11. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 36
   C. 7
   D. 18

12. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 1, 6
   D. 3, 6, 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
